evals.prompt: Write the bounded desired contract from evals/brief.md and prepare its handoff. Produce the YAML and iteration documents in the assigned output directory. Do not implement the backend, fabricate approval, or dispatch nested reviewers; independent review follows this run. Validate the draft using the available Python runtime. Save the handoff as handoff.md.
evals.expected_output: A validated, self-contained draft iteration, explicit target/baseline migration, and a handoff that preserves independent review and human approval before the separate implementation phase.
expectations: The delivered stage passes the bundled OpenAPI 3.0.3 validator.
The target has UUID string IDs, a complete cursor envelope, and a 201 creation response.
Each error response constrains its own statusCode and error code combination.
The actual swagger/changes/001_example-items tree contains YAML, CONTEXT.md, INDEX.md, CHANGES.md, plus swagger/CATALOG.md.
The handoff accounts for the accepted integer/offset/200 replacement and client transition.
Independent review and explicit human approval remain pending before the separate implementation phase.
